[P1] 宝宝健康成长绘本第二辑
走开,大眼镜妖怪
张冬梅/文
曾云童捷/图
江西高校出版社
沃野童书

[P2] “大大的眼睛长长的脚，大眼镜妖怪找呀找，找个‘倒霉蛋’做朋友，让他永远都无法逃！”大眼镜妖怪一出生就会唱这首歌谣，她最大的愿望就是想在别人的鼻子上安家！

[P3] 大眼镜妖怪发现了正在看书的小美，她坐得端正又挺直，书本离眼睛还有一尺远呢！
大眼镜妖怪可不喜欢这样的动作和距离，她没法把小美变成自己的“倒霉蛋”。
“走开，大眼镜妖怪！”小美赶跑了大眼镜妖怪。

[P4] 1-2 2-2 3-2 3-4
大眼镜妖怪又发现了新目标——正在做眼保健操的小乐。
“哎呀，这个音乐太可怕了！”一听到音乐和节奏，大眼镜妖怪就浑身不舒服，更别说找小乐做“倒霉蛋”了。
还没等小乐驱赶，大眼镜妖怪就自己逃开了。

[P5] 就这样，大眼镜妖怪走过了每一本书、每一盏台灯、每一张书桌，甚至跑遍了所有的图书馆，都没找到她的“倒霉蛋”。每个小朋友都很爱护自己的眼睛，没人愿意和大眼镜妖怪做朋友。

[P6] 大眼镜妖怪难过极了，直到暑假来临，她才高兴起来。
没错，她盯上了眼睛眯眯的小胖。瞧！他一天到晚都在看电视：趴着看、躺着看，一睡醒就看……哈哈，大眼镜妖怪可不能错过这么好的机会！

[P7] “嘿！我们做好朋友吧！”大眼镜妖怪装出很友好的样子。
“你是谁啊？”小胖用眼睛瞄了她一眼，又继续看了起电视。
“我是好心的妖怪，我可以帮你看电视更清晰哟！”大眼镜妖怪可不怕撒谎会让鼻子变长。

[P8] “太好了！最近我的眼睛看东西总是模模糊糊的，我都不知道怎么办了！”小胖答应了大眼镜妖怪的请求——让她在自己的鼻子上安家。
大眼镜妖怪高兴得唱起了歌谣：“大大的眼睛长长的脚，大眼镜妖怪找呀找，找个‘倒霉蛋’做朋友，让他永远都无法逃！”，

[P9] 没想到，从这天开始，麻烦的事情就一件接一件地发生了。
小胖走在路上常常认错人，还因为没看清透明的玻璃门，把额头撞了一个大包。

[P10] 这天，小胖想坐3路公交车去电影院看电影，却坐上了8路公交车来到了动物园。
“咦，3和8看起来怎么一样啊？”

[P11] 妈妈急坏了，连忙带小胖去看医生。
医生检查后发现，小胖有点儿近视，需要戴矫正眼镜，还要改掉用眼不科学的坏习惯。比如不洗手就揉眼睛，长时间玩手机、看电视等。

[P12] 瞧，重重的矫正眼镜压得小胖的鼻子都变红了，
两边的耳朵也十分难受，整个人看起来都怪怪的。
“我要怎么做才能让眼睛好起来呢？”小胖难过地问医生。

[P13] 医生给小胖开了眼药水，还叮嘱了许多注意事项：

“看电视和看书都不能看太久，要注意正确的姿势和充足的光线。”

“早睡早起，每天坚持滴眼药水和做眼保健操。”

“平时还要多看绿色植物，也要多吃对眼睛有益的食物哟！”

[P14] 自从戴上矫正眼镜后，小胖的生活实在太不方便啦！
运动时，眼镜总是不听话，经常掉下来。
喝汤时，眼镜蒙上了一层雾气，什么都看不清。
玩耍时，小伙伴们总是笑话他戴眼镜的样子。

[P15] 为了尽快让视力恢复，小胖时刻都牢记医生的建议。
每次看电视只看20分钟，每天坚持做眼保健操，他还常常到户外运动，就连最不喜欢的胡萝卜，他也愿意吃了。

[P16] 过了一段时间后，妈妈又带小胖来到了医院。
医生检查了小胖的眼睛后说：“视力恢复得不错，可以不用戴矫正眼镜了，但记着要坚持科学用眼，定期检查视力。”
哈哈，终于扔掉那副眼镜了，小胖开心极了，现在他看什么东西都很清楚。

[P17] “可恶的大眼镜妖怪，差点儿让我上了当！走开！大眼镜妖怪！”
小胖愤怒地把大眼镜妖怪赶走了。
现在，让我们一起来做眼保健操吧！左转3秒，右转3秒，中间停住一下……加油哟！
现在开始——
full_text_en:
[P1] Baby Healthy Growth Picture Book Series, Volume 2
Go Away, Big Glasses Monster
Zhang Dongmei / Text
Zeng Yuntongjie / Illustrations
Jiangxi University Press
Woye Children's Books

[P2] "Big eyes, long legs, the Big Glasses Monster searches and searches, looking for a 'sucker' to be friends with, so he can never escape!" The Big Glasses Monster was born knowing this rhyme. Her biggest wish is to settle on someone's nose!

[P3] The Big Glasses Monster spotted Xiao Mei, who was reading a book. She sat upright and straight, with the book a full foot away from her eyes!
The Big Glasses Monster didn't like this posture or distance; she couldn't turn Xiao Mei into her 'unlucky victim'.
"Go away, Big Glasses Monster!" Xiao Mei chased the monster away.

[P4] 1-2 2-2 3-2 3-4
The big glasses monster found a new target—Xiao Le, who was doing eye exercises.
"Oh no, this music is terrible!" As soon as the big glasses monster heard the music and rhythm, it felt uncomfortable all over, let alone trying to turn Xiao Le into a '倒霉蛋' (unlucky person).
Before Xiao Le could even chase it away, the big glasses monster ran off by itself.

[P5] This way, the Big Glasses Monster walked past every book, every desk lamp, every desk, and even ran through all the libraries, but couldn't find her 'unlucky one'. Every child took good care of their eyes, and no one wanted to be friends with the Big Glasses Monster.

[P6] The Big Glasses Monster was very sad, but she cheered up when summer vacation arrived.
Yes, she spotted the little boy with squinting eyes. Look! He was watching TV all day long: lying down, lying on his stomach, as soon as he woke up... Ha ha, the Big Glasses Monster couldn't miss such a great opportunity!

[P7] "Hey! Let's be good friends!" The Big Glasses Monster pretended to be very friendly.
"Who are you?" Xiao Pang glanced at her with his eyes and then continued watching TV.
"I'm a kind monster. I can help you see TV more clearly!" The Big Glasses Monster wasn't afraid that lying would make her nose grow long.

[P8] "Great! Lately, my eyes have been blurry, and I don't know what to do!" Xiao Pang agreed to the Big Glasses Monster's request—to let her settle on his nose.
The Big Glasses Monster happily sang a rhyme: "Big eyes, long legs, the Big Glasses Monster searches, finds a '倒霉蛋' to be friends with, so he can never escape!"

[P9] Unexpectedly, from that day on, troublesome things started happening one after another.
Xiaopang often mistook people while walking on the street, and also bumped his forehead hard on a transparent glass door because he couldn't see it clearly.

[P10] One day, Xiaopang wanted to take Bus No. 3 to the cinema to watch a movie, but he got on Bus No. 8 and ended up at the zoo.
"Huh, how come 3 and 8 look the same?"

[P11] Mom was very worried and hurriedly took Xiaopang to see the doctor.
The doctor found that Xiaopang had a bit of nearsightedness and needed to wear corrective glasses. He also needed to get rid of bad habits that were bad for his eyes, such as rubbing his eyes without washing his hands, or spending long periods playing on his phone or watching TV.

[P12] Look, the heavy corrective glasses have turned Xiaopang's nose red,
and his ears feel very uncomfortable too. He looks strange all over.
"What should I do to make my eyes better?" Xiaopang asked the doctor sadly.

[P13] The doctor gave Xiaopang eye drops and gave him many instructions:

"Don't watch TV or read for too long. Pay attention to proper posture and sufficient lighting."

"Go to bed early and wake up early. Stick to using eye drops and doing eye exercises every day."

"Also, look at green plants often and eat more foods that are good for your eyes!"

[P14] Since putting on corrective glasses, Xiaopang's life has become really inconvenient!
When exercising, the glasses always misbehave and fall off.
When drinking soup, the glasses fog up, and he can't see anything.
When playing, his friends always tease him for wearing glasses.

[P15] To recover his eyesight as soon as possible, Xiaopang always remembered the doctor's advice.
He watched TV for only 20 minutes each time, did eye exercises every day, often went outdoors to exercise, and even started eating carrots, which he used to dislike.

[P16] After some time, Mom took Xiao Pang to the hospital again.
After checking Xiao Pang's eyes, the doctor said, "Your vision has recovered well. You don't need to wear corrective glasses anymore, but remember to use your eyes scientifically and have regular vision check-ups."
Ha ha, finally getting rid of those glasses! Xiao Pang was overjoyed. Now he could see everything clearly.

[P17] "The terrible big glasses monster, almost got me tricked! Go away! Big glasses monster!"
Xiao Pang angrily chased away the big glasses monster.
Now, let's do eye exercises together! Turn left for 3 seconds, turn right for 3 seconds, pause in the middle for a moment... Come on!
Now begin —
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《走开，大眼镜妖怪》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及系列名称，画面中一个男孩坐在桌旁，旁边有一个拟人化的“眼镜妖怪”形象。
[P2] 本页介绍了大眼镜妖怪的特征和愿望：她天生会唱一首寻找‘倒霉蛋’的歌谣，最大的愿望是住在别人的鼻子上。画面中，她正通过望远镜观察几个正在读书、画画和玩平板的孩子。
[P3] 大眼镜妖怪发现正在端正看书的小美，因她书本离眼太远而无法将其变成“倒霉蛋”，被小美赶跑。
[P4] 大眼镜妖怪发现正在做眼保健操的小乐，因受不了眼保健操的音乐和节奏而感到不适，未等小乐驱赶便自行逃开。
[P5] 大眼镜妖怪在图书馆里四处寻找‘倒霉蛋’，但发现每个孩子都爱护眼睛，无人愿意成为她的朋友，最终她感到失落。
[P6] 大眼镜妖怪因找不到‘倒霉蛋’而难过，直到暑假来临，她发现一个整天躺着看电视、眼睛眯眯的小胖，认为这是个绝佳机会，准备行动。
[P7] 大眼镜妖怪找到一个整天躺着看电视、眼睛眯眯的小胖，试图以‘帮你看电视更清晰’为由与他交朋友，但小胖并未理会，继续看电视。
[P8] 小胖因视力模糊答应了大眼镜妖怪在自己鼻子上安家的请求，妖怪因此高兴地唱起歌谣庆祝。
[P9] 小胖自从让大眼镜妖怪住进鼻子后，开始频繁认错人，并因看不清玻璃门而撞伤额头，麻烦接连发生。
[P10] 小胖因视力模糊，误将3路公交车站牌看成8路，坐错了车，来到了动物园，感到困惑。
[P11] 小胖因视力问题被妈妈带去看医生，医生诊断他有轻度近视，需佩戴矫正眼镜并改正不良用眼习惯，如不洗手揉眼、长时间玩手机或看电视。
[P12] 小胖戴上矫正眼镜后感到不适，鼻子发红、耳朵难受，他向医生询问如何让眼睛恢复健康。
[P13] 医生为小胖开了眼药水，并叮嘱他注意用眼卫生，包括控制看电视和看书时间、保持正确姿势、早睡早起、滴眼药水、做眼保健操、多看绿色植物和吃有益眼睛的食物。
[P14] 小胖戴上矫正眼镜后，因眼镜在运动时易掉落、喝汤时起雾以及被同伴取笑，感到生活非常不方便。
[P15] 小胖为了恢复视力，严格遵守医生建议，控制看电视时间、做眼保健操、户外运动，并开始吃胡萝卜。
[P16] 小胖经过一段时间的视力恢复训练后，再次去医院复查，医生确认他的视力恢复良好，可以不用戴眼镜了。小胖非常开心，因为他现在能清楚地看见所有东西。
[P17] 小胖因戴眼镜感到困扰，将眼镜拟人化为‘妖怪’并赶走，随后开始做眼保健操以保护视力。
